meta_title: North Liverpool Garden Services | Gardener Liverpool
meta_description: North Liverpool Garden Services delivers expert garden maintenance, landscaping, and seasonal care across Liverpool. Professional results, competitive rates. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Local Family Business — Over 15 Years' Experience
hero_subhead: Overgrown borders and patchy lawn ruining your Liverpool garden? We transform outdoor spaces with expert planting, maintenance, and design.
services_subhead: From weekly maintenance to major landscaping projects, we handle every aspect of garden care with skill and attention to detail.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly visits keep your borders tidy, lawns healthy, and hedges shaped. We handle weeding, deadheading, pruning, and seasonal tidying so your garden stays guest-ready year-round.

services.title: Lawn Care & Seeding
services.desc: Scarifying, aeration, feeding, and overseeding bring patchy grass back to life. We diagnose compaction and drainage issues, then restore a thick, even lawn you'll be proud of.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Expert plant selection for your soil and light conditions ensures colour and structure every season. We design herbaceous and shrub borders that require minimal upkeep yet deliver maximum impact.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Pruning
services.desc: Neat hedges frame your garden and boost kerb appeal. We trim formal hedges, renovate overgrown specimens, and prune fruit trees and roses to encourage healthy growth and abundant flowering.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Landscaping
services.desc: Reclaim overgrown or neglected gardens. We clear vegetation, remove old features, and create the blank canvas you need for new patios, raised beds, or wildflower areas.

services.title: Seasonal Services
services.desc: Spring clean-ups, autumn leaf collection, winter gritting, and festive decorating keep your garden looking its best all year. We also organise skip hire and responsible garden waste removal.

about_pullquote: A tidy garden changes how you feel about your home. That's what we do.
about_para_1: North Liverpool Garden Services was started by two keen gardeners who got tired of seeing Liverpool's finest period properties let down by neglected outdoor spaces. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation for honest pricing, reliable workmanship, and genuine care for every plant we touch. We've transformed over 400 gardens across Liverpool—from pocket-sized terraced yards to sprawling suburban plots.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen. We don't upsell unnecessary work or rip out healthy plants. Instead, we diagnose what your garden actually needs, explain it clearly, and deliver results that last. Many of our clients have been with us for over a decade—that's the kind of trust we're proudest of.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Our garden was a complete wilderness when we bought the house. Mark and the lads came in, cleared the lot, and designed a stunning new layout with raised beds and a seating area. Couldn't be happier. Been using them monthly for maintenance ever since.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Had a nightmare hedge that was blocking all the light. They trimmed it back, shaped it properly, and it's now the best feature in our front garden. Really professional, turned up on time, cleared everything away. Fair price too.
reviews.author: Jacqui P.

reviews.text: Seasonal tidy-up in autumn turned into a full redesign because they spotted drainage issues nobody else mentioned. Fixed it properly, replanted with winter colour, and our garden's been gorgeous ever since. That's attention to detail you don't often find.
reviews.author: Sarah M.
